title: Genetically higher BMD raises knee osteoarthritis risk yet protects against fracture on pleiotropy-robust evidence
description: Analysis code, configuration, and reproduction material for the manuscript "Genetically higher BMD raises knee osteoarthritis risk yet protects against fracture on pleiotropy-robust evidence" (submitted to Osteoarthritis and Cartilage). The repository contains the full Python/R pipeline (LDSC genetic correlation across 78 phenotype pairs, two-sample Mendelian randomisation with MR-Egger / weighted median / MR-PRESSO / leave-one-out, multivariable MR conditioning on adult height, colocalisation, MRlap sample-overlap correction, and statistical power) and the derived outputs needed to reproduce every table and figure, including the multivariable-MR height grid and the colocalisation contrast. Raw GWAS summary statistics are not redistributed; they are publicly published (cited in the manuscript) and re-derived by the pipeline.
